recommendation: Keep this source fix. The current spec should continue to define the messaging framework and MessageDefinition mechanism while leaving actual message events and codes to implementations and implementation guides.
issue_request: FHIR-7948 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution to drop the messaging event-code list and the STU note about additional events, because message-event vocabulary is defined by local implementations and implementation guides.
initial_application: Historical source application happened in two steps: daae86217175 removed the STU note saying additional events may be defined elsewhere, and 2b81a477bd4d removed the rendered Event List, [%events%] macro, and table text for core-defined message event codes.
additional_context: Later FHIR-26902 and duplicate FHIR-34080 deleted the empty MessageEvent value set/code system and replaced core value-set references with descriptive MessageHeader/MessageDefinition bindings. That later cleanup is already represented on the combined branch and supports the same local/IG-defined event model.
reconciliation: Updated MessageHeader notes to point to the Defining Events section instead of a nonexistent list, changed the messaging/REST comparison to say an implementation can define a messaging event, and changed the push/pull page to say implementations can define message events.
source_changes: source/messageheader/messageheader-notes.xml: changed the stale link text from a messaging-page event list to the Defining Events section and message event definition.
source/messaging.html: changed wording that said the messaging framework defines a notification event to say an implementation can define one.
source/pushpull.html: changed wording that said FHIR defines message events for push and pull to say implementations can define them.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue deleted the empty MessageEvent value set/code system and removed core value-set references, reinforcing that current FHIR does not define message event codes; it is already represented on the combined branch.
Duplicate issue records the same concern that blank MessageEvent CodeSystem/ValueSet artifacts confused MessageHeader and MessageDefinition event-code users; it was used only as supporting context.
